occasions.title: Birthday
occasions.description: Warm wishes for their special day

greetings.text: Wishing you a wonderful birthday filled with love, laughter, and beautiful memories.
May your new year of life bring happiness, good health, and dreams come true.

occasions.title: Friendship
occasions.description: Celebrate the friends who make life brighter

greetings.text: Life is brighter and every memory is better because I have a friend like you.
Real friendship turns ordinary days into unforgettable memories.

occasions.title: Indian Hindu Festivals
occasions.description: Greetings for festivals celebrated across India

greetings.text: May the lights of Deepavali brighten your home with peace, prosperity, and happiness.
Happy Ugadi! May the new year bring fresh hope, good health, and success to your family.
Wishing you a joyful Dasara. May goodness triumph and courage guide every new beginning.
May Lord Ganesha bless you with wisdom, remove obstacles, and bring peace to your home.
Wishing you a happy Sankranti filled with warmth, abundance, and new beginnings.
May the colours of Holi fill your life with friendship, laughter, and renewed hope.
May the ideals of Lord Rama inspire truth, kindness, and strength in your life.
May the blessings of Lord Krishna fill your heart with love, wisdom, and joy.
May Navaratri bring you strength, courage, and the blessings of the Divine Mother.
On Maha Shivaratri, may you find peace, inner strength, and spiritual renewal.

occasions.title: Indian National Days
occasions.description: Patriotic greetings for important national observances

greetings.text: Happy Republic Day! May we uphold the values of our Constitution and work for a stronger, kinder India.
Happy Independence Day! Let us honour the freedom we share and contribute to a peaceful, inclusive India.
On Gandhi Jayanti, may truth, non-violence, and compassion guide our actions.
Let us celebrate Constitution Day by respecting justice, liberty, equality, and fraternity.
Happy Children's Day! May every child grow with safety, opportunity, curiosity, and joy.
On National Voters' Day, celebrate your voice and the responsibility of participating in democracy.

occasions.title: Karnataka Celebrations & Literary Legends
occasions.description: Celebrate Karnataka, Kannada language, and its poets and thinkers

greetings.text: Happy Karnataka Rajyotsava! May Kannada, our culture, and the spirit of Karnataka flourish for generations.
Remembering Kuvempu and his universal humanism. May his words inspire equality, wisdom, and compassion.
On Basava Jayanti, may the values of equality, dignity of labour, and compassion guide us.
May Kanakadasa's devotion, poetry, and message of equality continue to inspire us.
Honouring Purandara Dasa, whose compositions continue to enrich Karnataka's musical and spiritual heritage.
Let us cherish Kannada, read its literature, share its stories, and pass its beautiful heritage to the next generation.

occasions.title: Professional & Public Awareness Days
occasions.description: Appreciation and awareness greetings for service, science, and nature

greetings.text: Happy National Science Day! Stay curious, ask questions, and let evidence and discovery shape a brighter future.
Happy National Technology Day! May innovation solve real problems and improve lives.
Happy Engineers' Day! Celebrating the creativity and dedication that turn ideas into solutions.
Happy Doctors' Day! Thank you for your skill, compassion, and commitment to caring for others.
Happy Nurses' Day! Your kindness, resilience, and care make a lasting difference.
Happy Teachers' Day! Thank you for nurturing knowledge, confidence, and the courage to dream.
On the International Day of Forests, let us protect forests, restore nature, and safeguard biodiversity.
Happy World Environment Day! Small everyday choices can help protect our shared planet.
On World Water Day, let us conserve clean water and protect this essential resource for everyone.
Happy International Women's Day! Celebrate women's achievements and keep working for equality and opportunity.
Happy International Day of Yoga! May mindful movement and breathing support balance and well-being.
On World Mental Health Day, remember that listening, kindness, and seeking support are signs of strength.
Happy Earth Day! Let's care for our planet through thoughtful choices and collective action.
Happy Labour Day! Honouring the dignity, skill, and contribution of workers everywhere.
May this festive season bring peace to your home, joy to your heart, and hope for the days ahead.
Wishing you and your family happiness, prosperity, and togetherness.
